1.1: Mashkin bet hashshelachin bammoed uvashsheviit, ben mimmayan sheyyatza vattechilla, ben mimmayan shello yatza vattechilla. aval en mashkin lo mimme haggeshamim velo mimme hakkilon. veen osin ugiyyot laggefanim:
1.2: Rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, en osin et haamma vattechilla bammoed uvashsheviit, vachachamim omrim, osin et haamma battechilla bashsheviit, umetakkenin et hammekulkalot bammoed. umetakkenin et kilkule hammayim shebbirshut harabbim vechottin otan. umetakkenin et hadderachim veet harchovot veet mikvot hammayim, veosin kol tzarche harabbim, umetzayyenin et hakkevarot, veyotzin af al hakkilayim:
1.3: Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, moshchim et hammayim meilan leilan, uvilvad shello yashke et kol hassade. zeraim shello shatu lifne hammoed, lo yashkem bammoed. vachachamim mattirin baze uvaze:
1.4: Tzadin et haishut veet haachbarim missede hailan umissede hallavan, shello chedarko, bammoed uvashsheviit. vachachamim omrim, missede hailan kedarko, umissede hallavan shello chedarko. umekarin et happirtza bammoed, uvashsheviit bone chedarko:
1.5: Rabbi meir omer, roin et hannegaim battechilla lehakel, aval lo lehachemir. vachachamim omrim, lo lehakel velo lehachemir. veod amar rabbi meir, melakket adam atzmot aviv veimmo, mippene shessimcha hi lo. rabbi yose omer, evel hu lo. lo yeorer adam al meto velo yaspidennu kodem laregel sheloshim yom:
1.6: En chofrin kuchin ukevarot bammoed, aval mechannechim et hakkuchin bammoed. veosin nivrechet bammoed, vearon im hammet bechatzer. rabbi yehuda oser, ella im ken yesh immo nesarim:
1.7: En nosin nashim bammoed, lo vetulot, velo almanot, velo meyabbemin, mippene shessimcha hi lo. aval machazir hu et gerushato. veosa ishsha tachshiteha vammoed. rabbi yehuda omer, lo tasud mippene shenniuul hu lah:
1.8: Hahedyot tofer kedarko, vehaumman machliv. umesargin et hammittot. rabbi yose omer, af memattechin:
1.9: Maamidin tannur vechirayim verechayim bammoed. rabbi yehuda omer, en mechabbeshin et harechayim battechilla:
1.10: Osin maake legag ulemirpeset maase hedyot, aval lo maase umman. shafin et hassedakin umagilin otan bammagila bayyad uvaregel, aval lo vammachalatzayim. hatztzir vehatztzinnor vehakkora vehammanul vehammafteach shennishberu, metakkenan bammoed, uvilvad shello yechavven melachto bammoed, vechol kevashin shehu yachol leechol mehen bammoed, kovshan:

2.1: Mi shehafach et zetav veero evel o ones, o shehituhu foalim, toen kora rishona umannichah leachar hammoed. divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer, zolef vegomer vegaf kedarko:
2.2: Vechen mi shehaya yeno betoch habbor veero evel o ones, o shehituhu foalim, zolef vegomer vegaf kedarko, divre rabbi yose. rabbi yehuda omer, ose lo limmudim, bishvil shello yachmitz:
2.3: Machnis adam perotav mippene haggannavim, veshole fishtano min hammishra bishvil shello tovad, uvilvad shello yechavven et melachto vammoed. vechullan im kivvenu melachtan bammoed, yovedu:
2.4: En lokchin battim, avadim uvehema, ella letzorech hammoed, o letzorech hammocher, sheen lo ma yochol. en mefannin mibbayit levayit, aval mefanne hu lachatzero. en meviin kelim mibbet haumman. veim choshesh lahem, mefannan lechatzer acheret:
2.5: Mechappin et hakketziot bekash. rabbi yehuda omer, af meabbin. mochre ferot, kesut vechelim, mochrim betzina letzorech hammoed. hatztzayyadin vehaddashoshot vehaggarosot, osin betzina letzorech hammoed. rabbi yose omer, hem hechmiru al atzman:

3.1: Veellu megallechin bammoed, habba mimmedinat hayyam, umibbet hashshivya, vehayyotze mibbet haasurin, vehamenudde shehittiru lo chachamim, vechen mi shennishal lechacham vehuttar, vehannazir, vehammetzora haole mittumato letohorato:
3.2: Veellu mechabbesin bammoed, habba mimmedinat hayyam, umibbet hashshivya, vehayyotze mibbet haasurim, vehamenudde shehittiru lo chachamim, vechen mi shennishal lechacham vehuttar, mitpechot hayyadayim umitpechot hassapparim umitpechot hassefag, hazzavin vehazzavot vehanniddot vehayyoldot, vechol haolin mittuma letohora, hare ellu muttarin. ushear kol adam, asurin:
3.3: Veellu kotvin bammoed, kiddushe nashim, gittin veshovarin, deyateke, mattana uferozbulin, iggerot shum veiggerot mazon, shitre chalitza umeunim, veshitre verurin, ugezerot bet din, veiggerot shel rashut:
3.4: En kotvin shitre chov bammoed. veim eno maamino o sheen lo ma yochal, hare ze yichtov. en kotvin sefarim, tefillin umezuzot, bammoed, veen maggihin ot achat, afillu besefer (haazara) ezra. rabbi yehuda omer, kotev adam tefillin umezuzot leatzmo, vetove al yerecho techelet letzitzito:
3.5: Hakkover et meto shelosha yamim kodem laregel, batla hemennu gezerat shiva. shemona, batla hemennu gezerat sheloshim, mippene sheamru, shabbat ola veenah mafseket, regalim mafsikin veenan olin:
3.6: Rabbi eliezer omer, mishshecharav bet hammikdash, atzeret keshabbat. rabban gamliel omer, rosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim, kargalim. vachachamim omrim, lo chedivre ze velo chedivre ze, ella atzeret kargalim, rosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim keshabbat:
3.7: En korin, velo choltzin, veen mavrin, ella kerovav shel met, veen mavrin ella al mitta zekufa. en molichin levet haevel lo betavla velo veiskutela velo vekanon, ella vesallim. veen omrim birkat avelim bammoed, aval omdin beshura umenachamin ufotrin et harabbim:
3.8: En mannichin et hammitta barchov, shello leharegil et hahesped, velo shel nashim leolam, mippene hakkavod. nashim bammoed meannot, aval lo metappechot. rabbi yishmael omer, hassemuchot lammitta, metappechot:
3.9: Berashe chodashim, bachanukka uvefurim, meannot, umetappechot baze uvaze, aval lo mekonnot. nikbar hammet, lo meannot velo metappechot. ezehu innuy, shekkullan onot keechat. kina, sheachat medabberet vechullan onot achareha, shenneemar (yirmeya 9), velammedna venotechem nehi, veishsha reutah kina. aval leatid lavo hu omer (yeshaya ko), billa hammavet lanetzach, umacha Adonai elohim dima meal kol panim vegomer:
